Learning that feels like play

Growing capable minds, one happy lesson at a time.

LIMCO Abacus Training Center helps children in Himmatnagar strengthen the skills they use every day. Through abacus practice and playful brain-building activities, each child gets the chance to explore, practise and feel proud of their progress.

We believe encouragement matters. Our goal is to create a welcoming space where children can keep trying, enjoy the process and discover what they can do.

Come meet us ↗
Four ways to grow

Skills for every day

Short, lively exercises help children practise listening, visualising, speaking and writing.

01 / LISTEN

Listening

Jumble dictation invites children to listen closely, pick out details and follow what they hear—without making practice feel like a test.

02 / VISUALISE

Visualising

Flash cards give young minds something to notice and remember, helping them practise observation and mental recall.

03 / SPEAK

Speaking

Quick-answer activities give children gentle practice responding clearly, expressing ideas and growing comfortable speaking up.

04 / WRITE

Writing

Fun speed-writing rounds help children build writing fluency, practise at their own pace and take pride in what they put on paper.
